name: unicoach
description: UniCoach — YKS/LGS öğrenci yardım sistemi (web + mobil, ortak API)

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @unicoach/api -w @unicoach/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @unicoach/api" "npm run dev -w @unicoach/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
